blocks.text:
A boat excursion to Caño Island, an important archaeological and biological site in Costa Rica. With luck, you may see humpback whales, dolphins and orcas during the crossing.

The island is surrounded by 5 coral reef platforms. Underwater volcanic rocks provide a foundation for coral colonies, with numerous molluscs and fish living nearby. The area is considered one of the country's best for snorkelling and diving.

On arrival, you will have the opportunity to snorkel in the clear water around the island.

Overnight at **Rancho Corcovado**.

Meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
